detail.body:
### What does this PR do?

Adds RL support for **Muse Spark 816B-A42B** (NVFP4 MoE) on the FSDP2 engine: GRPO with LoRA against a vLLM rollout that serves the NVFP4 checkpoint, rollout routing replay (R3), and adapter-only weight sync. verl has no Muse Spark model, so the PR adds a verl-native text model and an example, plus the generic changes the run needs. The trainer reads the same NVFP4 checkpoint as vLLM and dequantizes the routed experts to BF16 while loading its FSDP2 shards. Each commit can be reviewed on its own:

| # | Commit | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `[fsdp] fix: bound the padded micro-batch size when use_remove_padding=False` | dynamic bsz without remove-padding |
| 2 | `[fsdp] feat: support R3 router replay` | FSDP engine, off by default |
| 3 | `[fsdp] feat: opt-in sharded FSDP2 init straight from safetensors` | `VERL_FSDP2_SHARDED_INIT=1` only |
| 4 | `[fsdp] feat: keep _keep_in_fp32_modules in fp32 FSDP units` | models declaring `_keep_in_fp32_modules` |
| 5 | `[fsdp, rollout] feat: stream model-native LoRA exports in adapter-only sync` | models defining `export_serving_lora` |
| 6 | `[rollout, vllm] fix: LoRA weight sync for checkpoint-quantized rollouts` | LoRA sync to vLLM |
| 7 | `[fsdp, model] feat: Muse Spark text model for FSDP2 LoRA RL` | `model_type == "muse_spark_text"` only |

**Dependency on vLLM.** The rollout needs a vLLM build that serves Muse Spark with LoRA on its fused attention
projection and routed experts. Those vLLM changes are being upstreamed separately.

### Test

- GPU: the example recipe on 4 nodes x 4 GB300, 150 steps from scratch. LoRA r32/α64 on attention, the MoE latent projections and the routed experts; GRPO with 32 prompts × 8 samples, lr 1e-5, 4096-token responses, R3. AIME-2024 mean@8 went from 0.56 to 0.85, and the train/rollout k3 KL stayed near 2×10⁻⁴.

![Muse Spark LoRA RL: AIME-2024 mean@8 and train/rollout k3 KL](https://github.com/andakai/verl/blob/8a16367eefcc92179eb99a9d8c476a9cad39fdb1/muse_spark_lora_rl_curves.png?raw=true)

### Usage

```bash
model_path=<Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4> bash examples/grpo_trainer/run_muse_spark_dapo_lora_fsdp.sh
```

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+#
+# GRPO (DAPO-Math-17K, AIME-2024 eval) | Muse Spark 816B-A42B NVFP4 | FSDP2 + LoRA | vLLM rollout | 4 nodes x 4 GPUs
+#
+# vLLM serves the NVFP4 checkpoint; the trainer runs verl/models/transformers/muse_spark on the same checkpoint
+# (routed experts dequantized to BF16 at load) and trains LoRA only, with R3. Needs a vLLM build that serves Muse Spark
+# with LoRA, and DAPO-Math-17K / AIME-2024 parquet files.
+
+set -xeuo pipefail
+
+# ---- user-adjustable ----
+model_path=${model_path:-$HOME/models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4}
+train_file=${train_file:-$HOME/data/dapo-math-17k.parquet}
+val_file=${val_file:-$HOME/data/aime-2024.parquet}
+ckpt_dir=${ckpt_dir:-$HOME/ckpt/muse_spark_dapo_lora}
+nnodes=${nnodes:-4}
+gpus_per_node=${gpus_per_node:-4}
+total_steps=${total_steps:-150}
+
+export VERL_USE_EXTERNAL_MODULES=verl.models.transformers.muse_spark.register
+export VERL_FSDP2_SHARDED_INIT=1  # each rank reads only its FSDP2 shards
+export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1
+export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
+
+# training config of the text model (the checkpoint config nests it under text_config)
+text_config=${ckpt_dir}/text-config
+mkdir -p "$ckpt_dir"
+python3 - "$model_path" "$text_config" <<'PY'
+import json
+import sys
+
+from verl.models.transformers.muse_spark.configuration_muse_spark import MuseSparkTextConfig
+
+config = json.load(open(sys.argv[1] + "/config.json"))
+MuseSparkTextConfig.from_checkpoint_config(config).save_pretrained(sys.argv[2])
+PY
+
+python3 -m verl.trainer.main_ppo \
+    algorithm.adv_estimator=grpo \
+    data.train_files="$train_file" \
+    data.val_files="$val_file" \
+    data.train_batch_size=32 \
+    data.max_prompt_length=1024 \
+    data.max_response_length=4096 \
+    data.filter_overlong_prompts=true \
+    data.seed=42 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.model.path="$model_path" \
+    actor_rollout_ref.model.hf_config_path="$text_config" \
+    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=false \
+    actor_rollout_ref.model.lora_rank=32 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.model.lora_alpha=64 \
+    "actor_rollout_ref.model.target_modules=[q_proj,k_proj,v_proj,o_proj,gate_proj,pre_expert_proj,post_expert_proj]" \
+    +actor_rollout_ref.model.override_config.attn_implementation=sdpa \
+    +actor_rollout_ref.model.override_config.expert_lora_rank=32 \
+    +actor_rollout_ref.model.override_config.expert_lora_alpha=64 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.strategy=fsdp2 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.model_dtype=bf16 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.router_replay.mode=R3 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=32 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=true \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.loss_agg_mode=seq-mean-token-mean \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.clip_ratio_high=0.28 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=1e-5 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.weight_decay=0.1 \
+    "actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.betas=[0.9,0.98]" \
+    ++actor_rollout_ref.actor.checkpoint.save_lora_only=true \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=4 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.load_format=safetensors \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=8 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.n=8 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.temperature=1.0 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.do_sample=true \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.60 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_num_seqs=64 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_num_batched_tokens=4096 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_model_len=5120 \
+    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.enable_rollout_routing_replay=true \
+    "+actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.limit_mm_per_prompt={image:0,video:0,audio:0}" \
+    trainer.nnodes="$nnodes" \
+    trainer.n_gpus_per_node="$gpus_per_node" \
+    trainer.total_training_steps="$total_steps" \
+    trainer.test_freq=10 \
+    trainer.save_freq=10 \
+    "trainer.logger=[console,tensorboard]" \
+    trainer.project_name=muse_spark_dapo \
+    trainer.experiment_name=grpo_lora_r32 \
+    trainer.default_local_dir="$ckpt_dir" "$@"

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from transformers import PretrainedConfig
+
+
+class MuseSparkTextConfig(PretrainedConfig):
+    """Muse Spark text model config: the checkpoint's ``text_config`` fields, kept verbatim."""
+
+    model_type = "muse_spark_text"
+    keys_to_ignore_at_inference = ["past_key_values"]
+
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(
+            pad_token_id=kwargs.pop("pad_token_id", 200018),
+            bos_token_id=kwargs.pop("bos_token_id", 200000),
+            eos_token_id=kwargs.pop("eos_token_id", 200001),
+            tie_word_embeddings=kwargs.pop("tie_word_embeddings", False),
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+        for name, value in kwargs.items():
+            setattr(self, name, value)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_checkpoint_config(cls, config: dict) -> MuseSparkTextConfig:
+        drop = ("model_type", "architectures", "quantization_config")
+        text = {k: v for k, v in config.get("text_config", config).items() if k not in drop}
+        return cls(architectures=["MuseSparkForCausalLM"], dtype="bfloat16", **text)
+
+
+__all__ = ["MuseSparkTextConfig"]

+# Copyright 2026 Bytedance Ltd. and/or its affiliates
+#
+# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+# You may obtain a copy of the License at
+#
+#     http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
+#
+# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+# limitations under the License.
+"""Muse Spark text model for FSDP2 LoRA RL; parameter names follow the HF checkpoint."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import nn
+from torch.utils.checkpoint import checkpoint
+from transformers import AutoConfig, AutoModelForCausalLM, PreTrainedModel
+from transformers.modeling_outputs import CausalLMOutput
+
+from .configuration_muse_spark import MuseSparkTextConfig
+
+
+def rms_norm(x, eps, weight=None, *, weight_first=False, zero_centered=False, out_dtype=None):
+    value = x.float()
+    gain = None
+    if weight is not None:
+        gain = weight.float() + (1.0 if zero_centered else 0.0)
+    if weight_first and gain is not None:
+        value = value * gain
+    value = value * torch.rsqrt(value.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    if not weight_first and gain is not None:
+        value = value * gain
+    return value.to(out_dtype or x.dtype)
+
+
+class MuseSparkRMSNorm(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, size, eps, *, weight_first=False, zero_centered=True):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.eps = eps
+        self.weight_first = weight_first
+        self.zero_centered = zero_centered
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(size))
+
+    def forward(self, x, out_dtype=None):
+        return rms_norm(
+            x,
+            self.eps,
+            self.weight,
+            weight_first=self.weight_first,
+            zero_centered=self.zero_centered,
+            out_dtype=out_dtype,
+        )
+
+
+class MuseSparkResidualGate(nn.Module):
+    """stream * alpha + branch * beta with beta = sigmoid(g / T), alpha = sqrt(sigmoid(-g / T) * (1 + beta))."""
+
+    def __init__(self, size, temperature):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.gate = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(size))
+        self.temperature = temperature
+
+    def forward(self, stream, branch):
+        w = self.gate.float() / self.temperature
+        beta = torch.sigmoid(w)
+        alpha = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(torch.sigmoid(-w) * (1.0 + beta), min=1e-3))
+        return alpha * stream.float() + beta * branch.float()
+
+
+def apply_rope(x, position_ids, theta):
+    """Half-split RoPE: q/k rows are in checkpoint order (vLLM reorders them for interleaved RoPE)."""
+    half = x.shape[-1] // 2
+    inv_freq = 1.0 / (theta ** (torch.arange(0, half, device=x.device, dtype=torch.float32) * 2 / x.shape[-1]))
+    angles = position_ids.float().unsqueeze(-1) * inv_freq
+    cos, sin = angles.cos().unsqueeze(2), angles.sin().unsqueeze(2)
+    x1, x2 = x.float()[..., :half], x.float()[..., half:]
+    return torch.cat((x1 * cos - x2 * sin, x1 * sin + x2 * cos), dim=-1).to(x.dtype)
+
+
+class MuseSparkAttention(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config, layer_idx):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.num_heads = config.num_attention_heads
+        self.num_kv_heads = config.num_key_value_heads
+        self.head_dim = config.head_dim
+        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5 * config.qk_scale_factor
+        self.rope_theta = float(config.layer_rope_theta[layer_idx])
+        self.sliding_window = (
+            int(config.sliding_window) if config.layer_types[layer_idx] == "sliding_attention" else None
+        )
+        self.eps = config.rms_norm_eps
+        q, kv, h = self.num_heads * self.head_dim, self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim, config.hidden_size
+        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(h, q, bias=False)
+        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(h, kv, bias=False)
+        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(h, kv, bias=False)
+        self.gate_proj = nn.Linear(h, q, bias=False)  # output gate
+        self.o_proj = nn.Linear(q, h, bias=False)
+
+    def _mask(self, attention_mask, seq_len, device):
+        idx = torch.arange(seq_len, device=device)
+        allowed = idx[None, :] <= idx[:, None]
+        if self.sliding_window is not None:
+            allowed &= idx[None, :] > idx[:, None] - self.sliding_window
+        allowed = allowed[None, None]
+        if attention_mask is not None:
+            allowed = allowed & attention_mask.bool()[:, None, None, :]
+            allowed = allowed | torch.eye(seq_len, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)[None, None]  # no empty pad rows
+        return allowed
+
+    def forward(self, x, position_ids, attention_mask):
+        b, s, _ = x.shape
+        q = self.q_proj(x).view(b, s, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+        k = self.k_proj(x).view(b, s, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
+        v = self.v_proj(x).view(b, s, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
+        gate = self.gate_proj(x).view(b, s, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+        q, k = rms_norm(q, self.eps), rms_norm(k, self.eps)
+        if self.rope_theta > 0:
+            q, k = apply_rope(q, position_ids, self.rope_theta), apply_rope(k, position_ids, self.rope_theta)
+        rep = self.num_heads // self.num_kv_heads
+        out = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
+            q.transpose(1, 2),
+            k.repeat_interleave(rep, 2).transpose(1, 2),
+            v.repeat_interleave(rep, 2).transpose(1, 2),
+            attn_mask=self._mask(attention_mask, s, x.device),
+            scale=self.scaling,
+        ).transpose(1, 2)
+        out = (rms_norm(out, self.eps, out_dtype=torch.float32) * torch.sigmoid(gate.float())).to(x.dtype)
+        return self.o_proj(out.flatten(-2))
+
+
+class MuseSparkRouter(nn.Module):
+    """Sigmoid scores, top-k on scores + bias, renormalized and scaled weights of the selected experts."""
+
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(config.num_local_experts, config.hidden_size, dtype=torch.float32))
+        self.e_score_correction_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(config.num_local_experts, dtype=torch.float32))
+        self.top_k = config.num_experts_per_tok
+        self.output_multiplier = config.output_multiplier
+        self.route_scale = config.routed_scaling_factor
+
+    def forward(self, x, routed_index=None):
+        """``routed_index``: R3 top-k expert ids; all-zero rows keep the native selection."""
+        with torch.autocast(device_type=x.device.type, enabled=False):
+            logits = F.linear(x.float(), self.weight.float() * self.output_multiplier)
+            scores = torch.sigmoid(logits)
+            index = torch.topk(scores + self.e_score_correction_bias.float(), self.top_k, dim=-1).indices
+            if routed_index is not None:
+                replay = routed_index.to(index.device, torch.long)
+                index = torch.where((replay != 0).any(-1, keepdim=True), replay, index)
+            weights = scores.gather(-1, index)
+            weights = weights / (weights.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-15) * self.route_scale
+        return weights, index
+
+
+try:  # as a PEFT tuner layer, PEFT trains, saves and disables it like its own LoRA
+    from peft.tuners.tuners_utils import BaseTunerLayer as _TunerLayer
+except ImportError:
+    _TunerLayer = object
+
+
+class MuseSparkExpertsLoRA(nn.Module, _TunerLayer):
+    """Shared-outer expert LoRA: gate_up A and down B are shared by all experts, the inner factors are per expert."""
+
+    adapter_layer_names = ("lora_gate_up_A", "lora_gate_up_B", "lora_down_A", "lora_down_B")
+
+    def __init__(self, e, h, i, rank, alpha):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.scaling = alpha / rank
+        self._active_adapter = "default"
+        self._disable_adapters = False
+        self.merged_adapters = []
+        self.lora_gate_up_A = nn.ParameterDict({"default": nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(rank, h))})
+        self.lora_gate_up_B = nn.ParameterDict({"default": nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(e, 2 * i, rank))})
+        self.lora_down_A = nn.ParameterDict({"default": nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(e, rank, i))})
+        self.lora_down_B = nn.ParameterDict({"default": nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(h, rank))})
+
+    def reset_lora_parameters(self):
+        """PEFT's default init: kaiming-uniform A, zero B."""
+        for a in (self.lora_gate_up_A["default"], self.lora_down_A["default"]):
+            nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(a.data.view(-1, a.shape[-1]), a=math.sqrt(5))
+        nn.init.zeros_(self.lora_gate_up_B["default"])
+        nn.init.zeros_(self.lora_down_B["default"])
+
+    @property
+    def active(self):
+        return not self._disable_adapters
+
+
+class MuseSparkExperts(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        super().__init__()
+        e, h, i = config.num_local_experts, config.moe_hidden_size, config.moe_intermediate_size
+        self.num_experts = e
+        self.gate_up_proj = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(e, 2 * i, h))
+        self.down_proj = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(e, h, i))
+        self.post_expert_norm = MuseSparkRMSNorm(h, config.post_norm_eps, weight_first=True, zero_centered=True)
+        r = getattr(config, "expert_lora_rank", 0)
+        if r:
+            self.lora = MuseSparkExpertsLoRA(e, h, i, r, config.expert_lora_alpha)
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states, top_k_index, top_k_weights):
+        shared = hasattr(self, "lora") and self.lora.active
+        if shared:
+            lo, dt = self.lora, hidden_states.dtype  # PEFT may keep the factors in fp32
+            s = lo.scaling
+            xa = F.linear(hidden_states, lo.lora_gate_up_A["default"].to(dt))
+            gu_b, d_a = lo.lora_gate_up_B["default"].to(dt).unbind(0), lo.lora_down_A["default"].to(dt).unbind(0)
+            d_b = lo.lora_down_B["default"].to(dt)
+        out = torch.zeros(hidden_states.shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=hidden_states.device)
+        for expert in torch.unique(top_k_index).tolist():
+            token, slot = torch.where(top_k_index == expert)
+            gate_up = F.linear(hidden_states[token], self.gate_up_proj[expert])
+            if shared:
+                gate_up = gate_up + s * F.linear(xa[token], gu_b[expert])
+            gate, up = gate_up.chunk(2, dim=-1)
+            act = F.silu(gate) * up
+            y = F.linear(act, self.down_proj[expert])
+            if shared:
+                y = y + s * F.linear(F.linear(act, d_a[expert]), d_b)
+            y = self.post_expert_norm(y, out_dtype=torch.float32)
+            out = out.index_add(0, token, y * top_k_weights[token, slot, None].float())
+        return out.to(hidden_states.dtype)
+
+
+class MuseSparkMoE(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.gate = MuseSparkRouter(config)
+        self.pre_expert_proj = nn.Linear(config.hidden_size, config.moe_hidden_size, bias=False)
+        self.pre_expert_norm = MuseSparkRMSNorm(config.moe_hidden_size, config.rms_norm_eps, zero_centered=True)
+        self.experts = MuseSparkExperts(config)
+        self.post_expert_proj = nn.Linear(config.moe_hidden_size, config.hidden_size, bias=False)
+
+    def forward(self, x, routed_index=None):
+        shape = x.shape
+        flat = x.reshape(-1, shape[-1])
+        if routed_index is not None:
+            routed_index = routed_index.reshape(-1, routed_index.shape[-1])
+        weights, index = self.gate(flat, routed_index)
+        pooled = self.pre_expert_norm(self.pre_expert_proj(flat))
+        return self.post_expert_proj(self.experts(pooled, index, weights)).view(*shape[:-1], -1)
+
+
+class MuseSparkDecoderLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config, layer_idx):
+        super().__init__()
+        t = config.residual_gate_temperature
+        self.input_layernorm = MuseSparkRMSNorm(config.hidden_size, config.rms_norm_eps, zero_centered=True)
+        self.self_attn = MuseSparkAttention(config, layer_idx)
+        self.post_attention_residual_gate = MuseSparkResidualGate(config.hidden_size, t)
+        self.pre_feedforward_layernorm = MuseSparkRMSNorm(config.hidden_size, config.rms_norm_eps, zero_centered=True)
+        self.mlp = MuseSparkMoE(config)
+        self.post_feedforward_layernorm = MuseSparkRMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size, config.post_norm_eps, weight_first=True, zero_centered=True
+        )
+        self.post_feedforward_residual_gate = MuseSparkResidualGate(config.hidden_size, t)
+        self.post_norm_eps = config.post_norm_eps
+
+    def forward(self, stream, position_ids, attention_mask, routed_index=None):
+        dtype = self.self_attn.q_proj.weight.dtype
+        attn = self.self_attn(self.input_layernorm(stream, out_dtype=dtype), position_ids, attention_mask)
+        stream = self.post_attention_residual_gate(stream, rms_norm(attn, self.post_norm_eps, out_dtype=torch.float32))
+        ffn = self.mlp(self.pre_feedforward_layernorm(stream, out_dtype=dtype), routed_index)
+        return self.post_feedforward_residual_gate(

+
+class MuseSparkTextModel(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.config = config
+        self.embed_tokens = nn.Embedding(config.vocab_size, config.hidden_size)
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(MuseSparkDecoderLayer(config, i) for i in range(config.num_hidden_layers))
+        self.norm = MuseSparkRMSNorm(config.hidden_size, config.rms_norm_eps, zero_centered=False)
+        self.gradient_checkpointing = False
+
+    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, position_ids, routed_experts=None):
+        """``routed_experts``: [B, S, num_layers, top_k] expert ids for R3."""
+        stream = rms_norm(self.embed_tokens(input_ids), self.config.rms_norm_eps, out_dtype=torch.float32)
+        for i, layer in enumerate(self.layers):
+            routed = None if routed_experts is None else routed_experts[:, :, i]
+            if self.gradient_checkpointing and self.training:
+                stream = checkpoint(layer, stream, position_ids, attention_mask, routed, use_reentrant=False)
+            else:

+        return self.norm(stream, out_dtype=self.embed_tokens.weight.dtype)

+    supports_gradient_checkpointing = True

+    _keep_in_fp32_modules = ["mlp.gate"]

+            module.weight.data.normal_(mean=0.0, std=std)
+        elif isinstance(module, MuseSparkExperts):
+            module.gate_up_proj.data.normal_(mean=0.0, std=std)
+            module.down_proj.data.normal_(mean=0.0, std=std)
+        elif isinstance(module, MuseSparkExpertsLoRA):
+            module.reset_lora_parameters()
+        elif isinstance(module, MuseSparkRouter):
+            module.weight.data.normal_(mean=0.0, std=std)
+            module.e_score_correction_bias.data.zero_()

+class MuseSparkForCausalLM(MuseSparkPreTrainedModel):
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        super().__init__(config)
+        self.model = MuseSparkModel(config)
+        self.lm_head = nn.Linear(config.hidden_size, config.vocab_size, bias=False)
+        self.post_init()
+        if getattr(config, "expert_lora_rank", 0):
+            # freeze the base: PEFT keeps existing trainability once the model holds a tuner layer
+            for name, param in self.named_parameters():
+                param.requires_grad_(".experts.lora." in name)
+
+    def export_serving_lora(self, params, peft_scaling):
+        """Expand the shared-outer expert LoRA to the per-expert layout vLLM loads (A rows expert-major, B columns
+        ``rank * E + expert``); the expert scaling relative to ``peft_scaling`` is folded into B."""
+        c = self.config.expert_lora_alpha / self.config.expert_lora_rank / peft_scaling
+        out = {}
+        for name, t in params.items():
+            prefix, sep, factor = name.rpartition(".experts.lora.lora_")
+            if not sep:
+                out[name] = t
+                continue
+            e = self.config.num_local_experts
+            stem = f"{prefix}.experts"
+            if factor == "gate_up_A":  # (r, H) shared -> (E*r, H)
+                out[f"{stem}.base_layer.lora_A.weight"] = t[None].expand(e, *t.shape).reshape(-1, t.shape[-1])
+            elif factor == "gate_up_B":  # (E, 2I, r) -> (2I, r*E)
+                out[f"{stem}.base_layer.lora_B.weight"] = (c * t).permute(1, 2, 0).reshape(t.shape[1], -1)
+            elif factor == "down_A":  # (E, r, I) -> (E*r, I)
+                out[f"{stem}.lora_A.weight"] = t.reshape(-1, t.shape[-1])
+            elif factor == "down_B":  # (H, r) shared -> (H, r*E)
+                out[f"{stem}.lora_B.weight"] = (c * t)[:, :, None].expand(*t.shape, e).reshape(t.shape[0], -1)
+            else:
+                raise ValueError(name)
+        return out
+
+    def get_input_embeddings(self):
+        return self.model.language_model.embed_tokens
+
+    def set_input_embeddings(self, value):
+        self.model.language_model.embed_tokens = value
+
+    def get_output_embeddings(self):
+        return self.lm_head
+
+    def set_output_embeddings(self, value):
+        self.lm_head = value
+
+    def gradient_checkpointing_enable(self, gradient_checkpointing_kwargs=None):
+        self.model.language_model.gradient_checkpointing = True
+
+    def gradient_checkpointing_disable(self):
+        self.model.language_model.gradient_checkpointing = False
+
+    def prepare_inputs_for_generation(self, input_ids, attention_mask=None, **kwargs):  # read by PEFT
+        return {"input_ids": input_ids, "attention_mask": attention_mask, "use_cache": False}
+
+    def forward(
+        self, input_ids=None, attention_mask=None, position_ids=None, labels=None, routed_experts=None, **kwargs
+    ):
+        if position_ids is None:
+            position_ids = torch.arange(input_ids.shape[1], device=input_ids.device).expand_as(input_ids)
+        hidden = self.model.language_model(input_ids, attention_mask, position_ids, routed_experts)
+        logits = self.lm_head(hidden).float() * self.config.output_multiplier
+        if self.config.final_logit_softcapping is not None:
+            cap = self.config.final_logit_softcapping
+            logits = cap * torch.tanh(logits / cap)
+        loss = None
+        if labels is not None:
+            loss = F.cross_entropy(
+                logits[..., :-1, :].reshape(-1, logits.shape[-1]), labels[..., 1:].reshape(-1), ignore_index=-100
+            )
+        return CausalLMOutput(loss=loss, logits=logits)
+
+

+    AutoConfig.register(MuseSparkTextConfig.model_type, MuseSparkTextConfig, exist_ok=True)
+    AutoModelForCausalLM.register(MuseSparkTextConfig, MuseSparkForCausalLM, exist_ok=True)

+"""Build an FSDP2 model on the meta device and load each rank's shard straight from safetensors."""
+
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path

+import torch
+from safetensors import safe_open
+from torch.distributed.tensor import DTensor, Shard

+ENABLED = os.environ.get("VERL_FSDP2_SHARDED_INIT") == "1"

+# NVFP4 dequantization as in vLLM's reference (tests/kernels/quantization/nvfp4_utils.py, Apache-2.0)
+_E2M1 = torch.tensor([0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0])
+
+
+def dequantize_nvfp4(packed, block_scale, global_scale, block_size=16):
+    """uint8 [M, K/2] (low nibble first), FP8 block scales [M, K/16], FP32 global scale -> fp32 [M, K]."""
+    m = packed.shape[0]
+    nibbles = torch.stack((packed & 0x0F, packed >> 4), dim=-1).reshape(m, -1)
+    values = _E2M1.to(packed.device)[(nibbles & 0x07).long()] * torch.where((nibbles & 0x08).bool(), -1.0, 1.0)
+    k = values.shape[1]
+    scale = block_scale.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn)[:m, : k // block_size].float() / (1.0 / global_scale.float())
+    return (values.view(m, -1, block_size) * scale.unsqueeze(-1)).view(m, k)
+
+
+def _dequantize_experts(packed, block_scale, global_scale):
+    """[E, rows, K/2] experts with one global scale per expert or per row partition (e.g. [w1 | w3])."""
+    experts = []
+    for q, s, g in zip(packed, block_scale, global_scale, strict=True):
+        g, r = g.reshape(-1), q.shape[0] // g.numel()
+        experts.append(torch.cat([dequantize_nvfp4(q[i * r : (i + 1) * r], s[i * r :], g[i]) for i in range(len(g))]))
+    return torch.stack(experts)
+
+
+def init_lora_on_cpu(module: torch.nn.Module, dtype: torch.dtype, seed: int = 0) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Initialize the LoRA weights of a meta model on CPU, identically on every rank."""
+    from peft.tuners.lora import LoraLayer
+
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    for layer in module.modules():
+        if isinstance(layer, LoraLayer):
+            for adapter in layer.active_adapters:
+                layer.lora_A[adapter].to_empty(device="cpu")
+                layer.lora_B[adapter].to_empty(device="cpu")
+                layer.reset_lora_parameters(adapter, True)
+                layer.lora_A[adapter].to(dtype)
+                layer.lora_B[adapter].to(dtype)
+        elif hasattr(layer, "reset_lora_parameters"):  # model-native LoRA
+            lora = [child for name, child in layer.named_children() if name.startswith("lora_")]
+            for child in lora:
+                child.to_empty(device="cpu")
+            layer.reset_lora_parameters()
+            for child in lora:
+                child.to(dtype)
+    return {n: p.detach().clone() for n, p in module.named_parameters() if p.requires_grad}
+
+
+def _checkpoint_key(param_name: str) -> str:
+    return param_name.removeprefix("base_model.model.").replace(".base_layer", "")
+
+
+def load_sharded(module: torch.nn.Module, model_path: str, lora_init: dict[str, torch.Tensor], device) -> None:
+    """Fill each rank's Shard(0) rows of an FSDP2-wrapped meta model; NVFP4 experts are dequantized."""
+    module.to_empty(device=device)
+    weight_map = json.loads((Path(model_path) / "model.safetensors.index.json").read_text())["weight_map"]
+    handles: dict[str, object] = {}
+
+    def read(key, lo, hi):
+        shard = weight_map[key]
+        if shard not in handles:
+            handles[shard] = safe_open(str(Path(model_path) / shard), "pt")
+        return handles[shard].get_slice(key)[lo:hi]
+
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for name, param in module.named_parameters():
+            local = param.to_local() if isinstance(param, DTensor) else param.data
+            lo, hi = 0, param.shape[0]
+            if isinstance(param, DTensor):
+                assert param.placements == (Shard(0),), (name, param.placements)
+                rank, size = param.device_mesh.get_local_rank(), param.device_mesh.size()
+                chunk = -(-param.shape[0] // size)
+                lo, hi = min(rank * chunk, param.shape[0]), min((rank + 1) * chunk, param.shape[0])
+            assert local.shape[0] == hi - lo, (name, local.shape, lo, hi)
+            if name in lora_init:
+                rows = lora_init[name][lo:hi]
+            else:
+                key = _checkpoint_key(name)
+                rows = read(key, lo, hi).to(local.device)
+                if f"{key}_weight_scale_2" in weight_map:
+                    scales = (read(f"{key}_weight_scale{s}", lo, hi).to(local.device) for s in ("", "_2"))
+                    rows = _dequantize_experts(rows, *scales)
+            local.copy_(rows.to(local.dtype))

+def rearrange_micro_batches_padded(batch, max_token_len, dp_group=None, same_micro_num_in_dp=True):
+    """Like ``rearrange_micro_batches``, but bounds the padded size (B x longest sample) of each micro-batch."""
+    input_ids = batch["input_ids"]
+    if input_ids.is_nested:
+        lens = input_ids.offsets().diff().cpu().tolist()
+    else:
+        lens = batch["attention_mask"].sum(dim=1).cpu().tolist()
+    order = sorted(range(len(lens)), key=lambda i: lens[i])
+    sl = [lens[i] for i in order]
+    assert max_token_len >= sl[-1], f"max_token_len must be >= the longest sample: {max_token_len=} {sl[-1]=}"
+
+    # contiguous groups of the sorted lengths; a group costs its size x its longest length
+    def cut(bound):
+        groups, start = [], 0
+        for j in range(len(sl)):
+            if j > start and (j - start + 1) * sl[j] > bound:
+                groups.append((start, j))
+                start = j
+        return groups + [(start, len(sl))]
+
+    num = len(cut(max_token_len))
+    if dist.is_initialized() and same_micro_num_in_dp and dp_group is not None:
+        t = torch.tensor([num], device=get_device_name())
+        dist.all_reduce(t, op=dist.ReduceOp.MAX, group=dp_group)
+        num = int(t.item())
+    assert num <= len(sl), f"{num} micro-batches requested for {len(sl)} samples"
+    lo, hi = sl[-1], max_token_len  # smallest bound that needs at most num groups
+    while lo < hi:
+        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
+        lo, hi = (lo, mid) if len(cut(mid)) <= num else (mid + 1, hi)
+    groups = cut(lo)
+    while len(groups) < num:  # DP sync asked for more groups: split the costliest one
+        k = max(
+            (g for g in range(len(groups)) if groups[g][1] - groups[g][0] > 1),
+            key=lambda g: (groups[g][1] - groups[g][0]) * sl[groups[g][1] - 1],
+        )
+        s, e = groups[k]
+        groups[k : k + 1] = [(s, (s + e) // 2), ((s + e) // 2, e)]
+    micro_bsz_idx = [[order[j] for j in range(s, e)] for s, e in groups]

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

# Contributor License Agreement (CLA) assistant

Streamline your workflow and let CLA assistant handle the legal side of contributions to a repository for you. CLA assistant enables contributors to sign CLAs from within a pull request.

To get started, simply store your CLA as a GitHub Gist file then link it with the repository/organisation in CLA assistant. Then sit back and relax while CLA assistant:

- Comments on each opened pull request to ask the contributor to sign the CLA
- Allows contributors to sign a CLA from within a pull request
- Authenticates the signee with their GitHub account
- Updates the status of a pull request when the contributor agrees to the CLA
- Automatically asks users to re-sign the CLA for each new pull request in the event the associated Gist & CLA has changed
- Green lights merge queues without additional CLA checks as everyone needs to have signed of on the PR level already

Repository owners can review a list of users who signed the CLA for each version of it. To get started, visit [cla-assistant.io](https://cla-assistant.io).
performed_via_github_app.name: CLA Assistant
